hooks.command: ls -t "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/handoff/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -8 | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$h" ] || { h=1; echo "Handoff notes in handoff/ (newest first; see CLAUDE.md \"Session handoff notes\"). Read any that touch your task:"; }; echo "- handoff/$(basename "$f") ($(date -r "$f" +%F)) $(sed -n 1p "$f" | sed "s/^# *//") [$(sed -n 2p "$f")]"; done; exit 0
